relevance_note: Single case report of a male with Danon disease: "a 22-year-old Caucasian male student who had undergone heart transplantation at the age of 12 due to hypertrophic cardiomyopathy associated with LAMP2-positive Danon disease".
method_note: Hand extraction from a short case report (no tables, no supplement); a small Python script in scratch assembled the JSON and checked spans. One in-scope person, labelled 'patient' (rule 5). The paper prints no LAMP2 variant; it says only 'LAMP2-positive Danon disease', so a variant row is kept with variant_original_string 'not reported' (it is unclear whether 'LAMP2-positive' refers to a genetic finding). The patient-specific sentences cite reference [9] (Regelsberger 2009, 'Danon disease: case report and detection of new mutation'), recorded as a probable prior report of the same patient; the paper does not say so in words. Age 22 is the age at PTLD diagnosis (March 2015) and in the abstract; recorded as age at last evaluation/report; no age at Danon onset or diagnosis is given. Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy recorded as checklist 'left ventricular hypertrophy' observed. 'a retinopathy/myopia' split into two observed features; retinopathy type is not stated, so the checklist item 'pigmentary retinopathy or retinal dystrophy' is left not reported. 'systolic function ... remained unaffected' after treatment refers to the transplanted heart and to change, not to a normal finding, so no LV checklist item is excluded. Treatment-related events (febrile neutropenia, abdominal pain, vomiting, distended loops, ileus) are recorded as observed features. Vital status 'alive' inferred from 'is still in metabolic complete remission'. No contradictions found.
